scope: Independent draft; never replace root interface-contract.json

b1d_r1_confirmation.backend_pm: B1-D r1 confirmed by the existing backend design review
b1d_r1_confirmation.legacy_gets: Existing GET /admin/users, GET /admin/users/:guid and GET /admin/users/:guid/behavior retain fresh actor/session/Redis, users.read and target hierarchy filtering, always exclude deleted; behavior retains model_preferences. They are not B1-D v2 FE routes, and legacy write/log/alerts routes remain outside this slice.
b1d_r1_confirmation.candidate_review: frontend implementation remains subject to independent quality review and PM final review; this draft remains DRAFT

common.auth: Existing Bearer/Refresh session client; admin routes require current authenticated user
common.guid: External GUID is decimal string; internal ids never exposed
common.time: Frozen B1-D UserReadDTO timestamps are UTC RFC3339 text ending in Z; other draft interfaces remain pending

auth_projection.shape: admin_permissions is a copied unique array of known available capabilities excluding unavailable users.quota.adjust; permissions_version is 0 or a canonical non-negative decimal int64 string
auth_projection.fresh_identity: known invalid identity is 401 and unavailable identity is 503; only an otherwise valid identity with unavailable policy omits both fields
auth_projection.frontend_replacement: each successful source replaces the in-memory projection; either missing or invalid field clears both and grants no admin capability; PUT users/me is not a projection source

interfaces.name: admin_users_list

query.q: trimmed literal valid UTF-8 search, maximum 128 Unicode runes; lone surrogate is invalid
query.status: active|disabled|deleted; omitted means active+disabled and must not be encoded as active,disabled
query.order: asc|desc; invalid sort/order pair falls back to guid desc

response.shape: exact fields: items,total,page,page_size; unknown fields reject
response.pagination: total/page/page_size are validated; an empty requested page with total>0 is a valid response. FE retries the last valid page once only, then synchronizes its current-page control.
response.order: requested sort with GUID as deterministic tie-breaker

interfaces.capability: users.read; deleted filter additionally requires users.deleted.read
interfaces.visibility: current fresh authenticated Admin may list User targets; Root may list User and Admin targets; deleted targets remain capability-gated

headers.X-Request-ID: present on success and all route errors

body.detail: safe Chinese detail only; request ID is header-only

errors_override.401: 认证会话无效 (existing middleware 401 body remains legacy format)
errors_override.403: 无权限访问 (including deleted filter without users.deleted.read)

interfaces.name: admin_user_create
interfaces.request: username/nickname/password/role/group/plan + Idempotency-Key; admin creation additionally consumes existing action-verification intent/ticket; exact fields pending
interfaces.capability: users.create; admin creation requires verified ticket

interfaces.name: admin_user_detail

request.path_guid: canonical positive decimal signed int64 string (1..9223372036854775807), no sign/whitespace/leading zero; no query; unknown/repeated query rejects

response.timestamps: UTC RFC3339 ending in Z; last_login_at may be null

interfaces.visibility: current fresh authenticated Admin may view User; Root may view User or Admin. Self, Root, missing, and deleted/non-visible targets return indistinguishable 404.

headers.X-Request-ID: present on success and all route errors

body.detail: safe Chinese detail only; request ID is header-only

errors_override.401: 认证会话无效 (existing middleware 401 body remains legacy format)
errors_override.404: 用户不存在 (including hidden deleted or non-visible target)

interfaces.name: admin_user_action
interfaces.request: explicit versioned action (including sessions.revoke) + reason + optional action ticket + Idempotency-Key
interfaces.response: operation reference/action result; exact schema pending

interfaces.name: action_verification
interfaces.request: action union: users.create_admin + complete canonical intent + actor password, or reset_password/promote/demote/permissions.write/delete + existing targetGUID + actor password; sensitive action registry pending B0
interfaces.response: users.create_admin returns reserved GUID plus high-entropy opaque single-use ticket; other sensitive actions return opaque ticket; client memory only, server stores digest only
interfaces.capability: action-specific; users.create_admin is Root-only hard boundary

interfaces.name: authz_catalog
interfaces.capability: exact active non-deleted Admin or Root with fresh authenticated session

headers.X-Request-ID: present on success and all errors for the two registered routes; existing gatewayRequestID validates or generates before authentication

errors_common_override.request_id: header X-Request-ID only; no request_id body field; overrides common.error_fields for this slice
errors_common_override.classification: missing actor/session or known disabled/deleted/stale/revoked/expired authentication (including Redis revoked) => 401; nonpositive persisted security versions/unknown actor role/status => 503; SQL/Redis I/O => 503; current valid actor without route role => 403 after fresh session and Redis validation

interfaces.validation_scope: matched route parameters only; unmatched paths retain existing Gin 404/standard redirect semantics
interfaces.authority: read-only display hints; never use to enable existing write endpoints; no ticket/idempotency/outbox added

interfaces.name: user_permissions_get

request.path_guid: canonical positive decimal signed int64 string (1..9223372036854775807); no sign, whitespace or leading zero

response.permissions_version: nonnegative decimal string; no head and no override history => 0; valid empty head retains positive version

item_fields.name: string
item_fields.policy_effective: boolean: deny first, then grantable allow, then baseline; Root-only/unavailable always false

interfaces.capability: exact Root with fresh authenticated session; target must be a non-deleted Admin (active or disabled)

headers.X-Request-ID: present on success and all errors for the two registered routes; existing gatewayRequestID validates or generates before authentication

errors_common_override.request_id: header X-Request-ID only; no request_id body field; overrides common.error_fields for this slice
errors_common_override.classification: missing actor/session or known disabled/deleted/stale/revoked/expired authentication (including Redis revoked) => 401; nonpositive persisted security versions/unknown actor role/status => 503; SQL/Redis I/O => 503; current valid actor without route role => 403 after fresh session and Redis validation

interfaces.validation_scope: matched route parameters only; unmatched paths retain existing Gin 404/standard redirect semantics
interfaces.authority: read-only display hints; never use to enable existing write endpoints; no ticket/idempotency/outbox added
interfaces.target_visibility: after fresh actor/session/Redis validation: missing, non-visible deletion state, self, known Root or User => identical 404 even if hidden target status/AuthVersion is invalid; only otherwise-visible targets with unknown role/status/nonpositive security version or corrupt policy => fixed 503

interfaces.name: operation_query
interfaces.request: scope is a finite registered dangerous-action set (examples: users.create/users.delete/public_content.publish); original Idempotency-Key header + Bearer; no arbitrary path/target GUID
interfaces.response: processing/succeeded/failed/pending_recovery + finished_at + opaque safe association; no target/input hash/ticket/password
interfaces.capability: same current originating session and latest actor management qualification; resource detail separately rechecks target visibility

security_notes.soft_delete: No restore or physical delete; username remains reserved
security_notes.money: No production balance table or adjustment interface; unknown money fields/actions reject
security_notes.ticket_t01: Intent is established first; POST users consumes existing ticket/intent and creates account, default permissions/entitlements, audit, idempotency and outbox in one transaction. Ticket is opaque client-memory value; server stores digest only
security_notes.policy_t02: Vue prerender + Go gate; switching/policy commit and cache invalidation details pending
security_notes.seo: Protected price shell contains no price metadata and is noindex; published price responses no-store
security_notes.result_query: Only operation_query may resolve a submitted action; detail/audit/session endpoints are current state/history and must not be treated as action results. Missing record means unable to confirm, not not-executed; no automatic replay
security_notes.capability_invalidation: user status/permission/plan/group/model ACL/password reset changes invalidate AuthVersion/sessions/Gateway ACL; DB latest-state read fail closed; outbox is propagation only
security_notes.mock_build_gate: production build/deploy must hard reject Mock configuration and omit demo entry/synthetic data; existing VITE_USE_MOCK warning is insufficient
pending: operation query final choice and key binding
